title: V-CRISP Synthetic Discrete-Event Assembly Benchmark
description: Reproducible artifact for a deliberately limited synthetic discrete-event assembly benchmark. The release contains executable source code, authoritative per-episode records, analysis tables, publication figures, formal citation metadata, and SHA-256 checksums. It evaluates an abstract finite-state model only; it is not evidence of physical-robot performance, perception, geometric task and motion planning, independent safety verification, or deployment readiness. Executable source code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Synthetic benchmark records and publication figures are licensed under CC-BY-4.0. The unpublished manuscript is not included in this artifact.
